book.name: Matiu
book.title: Toto Thovuye Utuniye Matiu Le Rorori

content: Va e mbaŋaŋgiko thiyako Jon Rabapɨtaiso i mena Judiya e njamnjamɨniye na i vavagharewe
iŋa, “Hu uturaŋgiya lemi tharɨ na hu roiteteŋgi, kaiwae Loi le ghamba mbaro ghambaŋa maiyavara.”
Jon iya utuniya Loi ghalɨŋae gharautu, Aiseya va i utuŋama, iyava iŋake,

content.text: hu varumwaru kamwathɨ amalaghɨniye kaiwae na mbala i reŋawe!’”

content: Jon ghakwama va thɨ vakatha kamel vulivuliye. Mborowae gheva thetheghan njimwae na i ghanɨŋgiya bibita na ŋguyo.
Gharɨgharɨ thɨ rakamenawe, vavana thɨ rakamena Jerusalem, vavana Judiya ele valɨvaŋgako laghɨye na vavana thɨ rakamena e vanautumako laghɨye e Walaghɨta Jorɨdan ghadidiye.
Thɨ uturaŋgiya lenji tharɨ na Jon i bapɨtaisoŋgi Jorɨdan.

Ko iyemaeŋge mbaŋa i thuweŋgiya Parisi na Sadusi thɨ rakamenawe bapɨtaiso kaiwae, i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Ghemi mwata raraitharɨ ghemi! Thela i dage e ghemi na hu munjeva ne hu voiteta Loi le ghatemuruko vuyowae iya i menamenako?
Hu vaemunjoruŋa e lemi vakathana kaero hu uturaŋgiya lemi tharɨ na hu roiteteŋgi.

Na thava lemi renuwaŋa hu munjeva ne hu voiteta vuyowoko iyako kaiwae huŋa, ‘Ghime rumbuma Eibraham.’ Ya dage e ghemi, Loi valɨkaiwae i mbanɨŋgiya varɨvarɨke thiyake na i vakathaŋgiya Eibraham orumburumbuye.
E mbaŋake iyake kelumo kaero ina vara e umbwaumbwa rɨgherɨghenji. Umbwa regha na regha ma i rau na thovuye ne i ikuyathu na i bigiyathu e ndɨghe une.”

“Ghino ya bapɨtaisoŋga e mbwa na i vatomwe kaero hu uturaŋgiya lemi tharɨ na hu roiteteŋgi, ko iya loloko i rereghamba e ghereiŋguke, iye ne i bapɨtaisoŋga e Nyao Boboma na e ndɨghe une. Ma elo thovuye na valɨkaiwaŋgu ne ya bigiya gheghe ghae.

Le savɨrɨ wit kaiwae kaero ina e nɨmae, ne i ghatha mbombouyeko weiye wokiwokiniyeko. Ne i mbana mbombouyeko na i vathe e ghaŋgolo na wokiwokiniyeko i ŋambu e ndɨgheko iya ma mbaŋa regha ne i mareko.”
E mbaŋako iyako e tɨne Jisas i ri Galili na i wa Jorɨdan, na i bapɨtaiso weya Jon.
Jon i munjeva ne i vɨva Jisas le renuwaŋa, i dagewe, iŋa, “Ghen eŋge mbala u bapɨtaisoŋgo, na ghen mo menava e ghino?”
Ko Jisas i gonjoghawe, iŋa, “Mbowo ŋgoreiyako e mbaŋake iyake, kaiwae e kamwathɨke iyake ne ra vakatha Loi le renuwaŋa thovuye.” Jon i wovathovuthovuyeŋa.
Mbaŋa i bapɨtaisovao na i voro e mbwako ghadidiye, e mbaŋako iyako buruburu i mavu na i thuweya Nyao Boboma i njamawe ŋgoreiya bunebune.
Amba ghalɨghalɨŋa i mena e buruburu iŋa, “Loloke iyake naruŋgu moli gharegharethovuniye. I vakathaŋgo ya warari laghɨye moli.”
